metadatos.titulo: Yalope — The match for actors and actresses
metadatos.descripcion: Yalope connects actors, actresses and creators with a quick, visual match: when the interest is mutual, the chat opens. Build your team and share your profile as a booking page.

manifest.descripcion: Yalope connects actors, actresses and creators with a quick, visual match: when the interest is mutual, the chat opens.

marcoAcceso.texto: Yalope connects people with an idea to people who want to make it happen.
marcoAcceso.argumento1Detalle: Real roles in productions coming together near you.
marcoAcceso.argumento2Titulo: Build a team without a project
marcoAcceso.argumento2Detalle: Meet people eager to create, even before you have the idea.
marcoAcceso.argumento3Detalle: Once there's a team, a room opens with the whole cast.
